name: Auth:SecretHigh
desc: Secret key (high word) for access control

name: Auth:SecretLow
desc: Secret key (low word) for access control

name: Speed:Min
desc: Minimum motor speed; below this motor stops

name: AnalogInput:Stop
desc: AI voltage below which motor stops

name: Failsafe:Mode
desc: Mode used when RS-485 communication is lost

name: Journal:Skip
desc: Skip first N records in journal query (0 = skip nothing)

name: Journal:Read
desc: Trigger journal read with code filter

name: Fault:Reset
desc: soft: reinit interfaces; hard: reboot both MCUs; fcty: hard reset and wipe stored config

name: Debug:RiseDelta
desc: Acceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:FallDelta
desc: Deceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:IrGain
desc: IR compensation gain at current frequency

name: Debug:IrBoost
desc: IR boost applied to modulation index

name: Debug:CurrReduce
desc: Hz subtracted from setpoint by current limiter [0:inactive]

name: Debug:RampGain
desc: Ramp stretch gain at current frequency

name: Debug:PeakCount
desc: Peak overcurrent events since last clear

name: Speed:DerateTemp
desc: Temperature above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Speed:DerateCurr
desc: Current above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Thresh:CurrRms
desc: RMS current threshold for emergency shutdown

name: Thresh:CurrPeak
desc: Peak current threshold for emergency shutdown

name: Thresh:PeakCount
desc: Cumulative peak events since last clear before fault triggers

name: Thresh:SyncScale
desc: Sync loss: tolerance proportional to rendered frequency

name: Thresh:SyncTimeout
desc: Sync loss: time before fault triggers

name: Thresh:StartFreq
desc: Sync loss and adaptive control: disabled below this frequency

name: Fault:RetryDelay
desc: Extra delay after braking before auto-retry (min 1s enforced)

name: Fault:RetryTimeout
desc: Fault-free time to reset retry counter

name: Ctrl:BootDelay
desc: Stabilization delay after DC bus reaches Thresh:DcBusMin

name: Pwm:InitFreq
desc: Starting frequency for initial rotor alignment

name: Pwm:ClampShort
desc: Short-pulse suppression in PWM timer counts [0:off]

name: Ramp:UpdateN
desc: Frequency step every N PWM cycles

name: Ramp:RiseDeltaBend
desc: Bend for acceleration slew rate curve

name: Ramp:FallDeltaBend
desc: Bend for deceleration slew rate curve

name: Brake:TimeStop
desc: Coasting time before restart at max frequency

name: Brake:StartDelay
desc: High-side enable delay before acceleration begins

name: MeasCfg:CountMin
desc: Minimum samples before slow tier update

name: MeasCfg:SchmittConst
desc: BEMF hysteresis: threshold = const + amplitude × SchmittScale/100

name: MeasCfg:FreqRangeConst
desc: BEMF valid frequency band: constant tolerance

name: MeasCfg:FreqRangeScale
desc: BEMF valid frequency band: proportional to rendered frequency

name: Const:TempA
desc: Linear temp sensor slope: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Const:TempB
desc: Linear temp sensor offset: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Adapt:StopFreq
desc: Reference frequency (x_max) for Adapt and Ramp bend functions

name: Adapt:IrGainStop
desc: IR voltage compensation gain at Adapt:StopFreq

name: Adapt:IrGainBend
desc: Bend for IR gain curve [>0: gain drops to Stop quickly at low freq]

name: Adapt:IrMax
desc: Maximum allowed IR boost on modulation index

name: Adapt:CurrLimitBend
desc: Bend for current limit curve [>0: limit rises to Stop quickly at low freq]

name: Adapt:CurrReduceGain
desc: Frequency reduction per ampere of overcurrent above Adapt:CurrLimit

name: Adapt:VdcLow
desc: DC-bus voltage below which acceleration ramp is stretched (see Adapt:VdcHigh)

name: Adapt:VdcHigh
desc: DC-bus voltage above which deceleration ramp is stretched (see Adapt:VdcLow)

name: Adapt:RampGainBend
desc: Bend for ramp stretch curve [>0: stretch drops to Stop quickly at low freq]

name: Stall:FreqEnd
desc: Stall protection disabled above this frequency (also bend x_max)

name: Stall:Bend
desc: Bend for stall current threshold curve [>0: drops to Stop quickly at low freq]

name: Journal:Count
desc: Number of records returned by last Journal:Read (0..32)
